facts.where: section "Claude trades on an EVE Online market" (Can agents make money?)
facts.quote: We first ran the models, and over 20 simple rule-based strategies, over nine different two-week windows.
facts.note: simulated rerun of the EVE Online market (a simulator replaying the buy and sell offers players posted); initial capital 3 billion ISK; fees and trading restrictions of human players applied; effort not written
